content.text:
Reviewed PR #57 at `b35be833`.

**CI failure:** All seven failed lint jobs stem from a Go/linter mismatch. The workflow selects Go `1.27.1` via `"stable"`, while golangci-lint `2.11.3` cannot decode its export data; e2e lint panics for the same reason. [Failed run](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/actions/runs/31906991804).

The fix already exists on `main` in [commit `0ef3709`](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/commit/0ef3709a8db8adb666e4a1bc65bfdb94c5e821a0): use `go-version-file`. Current main’s lint is green. Update this branch from main and run fresh CI.

**One P2 finding:** [Amp’s validator](https://github.com/entireio/external-agents/blob/b35be8330bcc6dbb5ad46439cf176a8a106415fe/agents/entire-agent-amp/internal/amp/agent.go#L70-L79) still accepts option-like IDs. I confirmed that the nonempty session ID `--last` produces:
```text
PLUGINS=all amp threads continue --last
```
That selects the latest thread instead of treating the supplied value as an ID. Reject leading hyphens and add a regression case. This is argument injection, not arbitrary shell execution.

Both changed modules pass `go test ./...` and golangci-lint locally with Go `1.26.0`. Hosted unit tests and protocol compliance also passed. No other actionable issues found; no changes pushed or review posted.
I’ll reject option-like session IDs in both adapters, add regression coverage, bring in the CI fix from main, and push the updated PR after validation.
